summary: End-to-end ML platforms unify data prep, experiment tracking, training, fine-tuning, model registry, deployment, and monitoring so teams can operationalize models at scale with governance and reproducibility. You need a full platform when you're managing many models, require MLOps workflows (versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, compliance), or train/fine-tune custom models; if you only need inference from a pre-built model, a hosted model API is far simpler and cheaper. The market is led by the hyperscaler suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and Databricks, with specialized tools filling experiment tracking, AutoML, and serverless GPU niches.

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/storage/endpoint hours; no upfront cost; SageMaker Studio free tier available
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already on AWS wanting a comprehensive managed ML lifecycle platform

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute; no surcharge for the service itself; enterprise agreements available
platforms.best_for: Microsoft/Azure-centric enterprises needing governance and responsible AI integration

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by training/prediction compute and node-hours; generative AI priced per token/request
platforms.best_for: GCP users and teams wanting tight integration with Gemini and BigQuery for GenAI and classic ML

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based via DBUs on top of underlying cloud compute; enterprise commitments available
platforms.best_for: Data-centric teams unifying data lakehouse, analytics, and ML/LLM workflows on one platform

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based team and enterprise plans
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated ML and governed deployment with limited data-science headcount

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source free tier; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and H2O AI Cloud
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting AutoML plus open-source flexibility and strong explainability

platforms.name: Vertex AI Pipelines / Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Open-source/free; cost is underlying Kubernetes infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Teams standardizing portable, Kubernetes-native MLOps across clouds

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Open-source/free; managed versions via Databricks or cloud vendors
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, framework-agnostic standard for tracking and model management

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing; free monthly credits for new users
platforms.best_for: Developers needing fast serverless GPU deployment and training without infra management

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + AutoTrain + Inference Endpoints)
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription; usage-based Inference Endpoints and compute
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source models and NLP/GenAI with easy fine-tuning and hosting
